name: Memories -before nightmare-
source:
When Lark opens his eyes, there is a girl in front of him. She smiles without fear even facing a wounded and bloodthirsty vampire. What beautiful eyes...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
当云雀睁开眼睛时，他的面前出现了一个女孩。即使面对受伤嗜血的吸血鬼，她也毫不畏惧地微笑。多么美丽的眼睛啊…

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
